# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When price deviates significantly from VWAP while the EMA ribbon is compressed, a subsequent break of structure signals a high-probability continuation. This captures momentum bursts in low-volatility environments where VWAP deviation indicates overextension and ribbon compression indicates consolidation, making a breakout more likely to trend.

## Mechanism
Compute EMA9, EMA20, EMA50; ribbon width = (max EMA - min EMA) / ATR(14). When ribbon width < 0.3 AND close > VWAP * 1.004 (>0.4% above VWAP) AND a bullish BOS occurs (price makes a higher high surpassing prior swing high with close above that high), enter long at the close of the BOS bar. Exit: chart-stop at prior swing low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 20% off HWM. Regime filter: only active when VIX < 15 and RTH after first 30 min (to avoid opening noise) and ADX < 20 (non-trending market).
